title: Poker Intelligence Platform — complete engineering plan

original_request.text: Bueno todo esto que dijiste y mas cosas(fitmulas matematicas etc) créamelo en sprint, spect o epic, la carpeta que sea necesario, para el harnes que voy adjuntarte. Voy hacer un nuevo repositorio con el harnes que voy a pasarte y estos archivos .json o.md para empezar a trabajar.
original_request.canonical_english: Create all durable planning and specification artifacts required by the attached engineering harness for a new repository that will build the most complete practical poker intelligence, statistics, mathematics, range/equity, solver, decision-support, HUD, review, and training platform possible, including epics, features, executable tasks, and an initial sprint.

translation.back_translation: Crear todos los artefactos durables de planificación y especificación requeridos por el harness de ingeniería adjunto para un repositorio nuevo que construya la plataforma práctica de inteligencia de poker, estadísticas, matemáticas, rangos/equity, solver, soporte de decisiones, HUD, revisión y entrenamiento más completa posible, incluyendo épicas, funcionalidades, tareas ejecutables y un sprint inicial.

refined_problem: Build a trustworthy local-first poker study and decision-analysis platform rather than a superficial HUD: the system must reconstruct legal game state, preserve raw provenance, define statistics by actual opportunities, implement audited poker mathematics, model weighted ranges and blocker effects, compute exact/simulated equity, estimate opponent/population behavior with uncertainty, combine baseline and exploit strategies, compare action EV, explain recommendations, and teach from recurring mistakes. Full no-limit equilibrium solving must be treated as an approximation/research problem with explicit limits rather than an unsupported claim of exact GTO.
target_users: Primary: the repository owner studying and playing No-Limit Texas Holdem in an environment where the intended live-assistance functions are permitted.
Secondary: future poker students who want post-session analysis, leak detection, drills, and transparent mathematical explanations.
outcomes: A deterministic hand/game engine that can serve live and post-session workflows.
A statistics system capable of hundreds of base metrics and thousands of contextual variants without bespoke code per variant.
Audited mathematical/equity/range outputs with reproducible tests and uncertainty.
A decision engine that reports action mixes, EV, confidence, sensitivity, and reasons.
A configurable desktop HUD plus replayer/trainer/reporting workflow.
A solver research path that can improve strategy quality without mislabeling approximations as exact equilibrium.

success_metrics.name: State reconstruction correctness
success_metrics.definition: Golden legal hands replay to expected stacks, pots, legal actions, and decision snapshots; invalid hands fail with explicit invariant errors.

success_metrics.name: Stat denominator correctness
success_metrics.definition: Canonical opportunity tests for all shipped base stats match independently specified expected successes/opportunities.

success_metrics.name: Equity numerical correctness
success_metrics.definition: Exact engine matches independent oracle fixtures; Monte Carlo converges within declared confidence/tolerance.

success_metrics.name: Decision reproducibility
success_metrics.definition: Same versioned inputs, seeds, strategies, and configuration reproduce the same decision result.
success_metrics.target: byte-stable deterministic outputs where sampling is seeded

success_metrics.name: Explainability coverage
success_metrics.definition: Every recommendation exposes strategy source, EV assumptions, opponent evidence, sample/confidence, and approximation status.

success_metrics.name: Interactive performance
success_metrics.definition: Common HUD/stat/decision interactions satisfy workload-specific budgets in PERFORMANCE_BUDGETS.md.
success_metrics.target: No benchmark budget regression on reference machine profile

in: No-Limit Texas Holdem cash-game foundation, 2-10 seats with 6-max as the primary UX target.
Configurable blinds, antes, effective stacks, side pots, rake/fees, heads-up and multiway.
Structured hand-history and structured live-event adapter contracts; post-session workflow always available.
Preflop through river statistics, board/sizing/position/stack/pot-type dimensions, Bayesian uncertainty, recency, and population comparison.
Weighted ranges, blockers, exact/Monte Carlo equity, EV, MDF, pot odds, SPR, exploit modeling, strategy lookup, solver prototypes, HUD, replayer, trainer, reports, export.
out: Guaranteeing profit or claiming any approximate strategy is universally optimal.
OCR/screen-scraping as a foundational dependency; it may be researched later if necessary.
Other poker variants before Holdem contracts are stable.
Cloud multi-user SaaS, payments, social features, or remote account management in the initial architecture.
Full exact solution of unrestricted multiway no-limit Holdem; use abstractions/re-solving/imported strategies with explicit provenance instead.

assumptions.statement: Primary game is No-Limit Texas Holdem cash; architecture remains extensible to tournaments and other variants.
The target play environment permits the intended live analysis/decision-support use described by the user.
assumptions.reversibility: high; live adapter can remain disabled while study mode proceeds

assumptions.statement: Local desktop first is preferred for latency/privacy; SQLite is the default operational store behind repository interfaces.
Python is the orchestration/product language; measured numerical hotspots may move to Rust/C++ only after profiling.
Strategy quality will improve incrementally from imported/precomputed baselines and solver research; provenance and approximation labels are mandatory.

open_questions.question: Which exact poker client/environment and structured live data source will be available?
Which stakes/rake schedule should be the first concrete configuration fixture?
Which precomputed strategy source, if any, will be imported first?

challenges.challenge: Statistics can be numerically correct but strategically wrong if opportunity denominators are wrong.
challenges.response: Opportunity engine + golden hand corpus + machine-readable definitions before UI.
Toy CFR correctness ladder, explicit abstractions, performance spike, and approximation metadata.

challenges.challenge: Sparse player samples produce misleading exploit conclusions.
challenges.response: Raw counts + Bayesian shrinkage + priors + intervals + confidence gates + sensitivity.

challenges.challenge: Live latency and concurrency can corrupt or stale decisions.
challenges.response: Immutable snapshots, versioned event ordering, cancellation, stale-state UI, deterministic traces.

challenges.challenge: Outcome variance can be confused with decision quality.
challenges.response: Separate realized winrate from modeled EV/regret and expose uncertainty.

mvp.goal: Deliver a trustworthy analytical vertical slice: import/reconstruct hands, persist them, compute core poker math and opportunity-correct stats, model ranges/equity, and replay/analyze decisions before advanced solver/HUD optimization.

work_items.title: Poker Intelligence Platform
work_items.description: Build a local-first poker intelligence and training platform that reconstructs games, computes rigorous statistics and poker mathematics, models ranges and opponents, evaluates candidate actions, supports solver-backed strategy baselines, and explains decisions through a configurable HUD, replayer, and trainer.
success_criteria: A normalized hand can be ingested once and deterministically reconstructed into a legal game state.
Statistics are opportunity-correct, filterable, uncertainty-aware, and reproducible.
Equity/EV outputs have deterministic test oracles and explicit numerical tolerances.
Decision outputs separate baseline strategy, exploit adjustment, confidence, and evidence.
The desktop application supports both live permitted-use analysis and post-session study from the same domain model.
risks: Incorrect opportunity definitions can silently corrupt strategic conclusions.
Full-game no-limit solving is computationally intractable without abstractions/re-solving; the product must not claim exact GTO where only approximations exist.

tasks.title: Implement canonical cards, table, seats, stacks, and actions
tasks.description: Implement immutable canonical domain types for cards, players, seats, positions, blind/ante configuration, chip amounts, streets, actions, pots, and table metadata. Enforce serialization stability and explicit units.
acceptance_criteria: Card identity is unique and validated for a standard 52-card deck.
Chip/money values never use binary float for authoritative amounts.
Actions encode actor, street, action kind, amount semantics, sequence order, and source provenance.
Round-trip serialization is deterministic and versioned.

tasks.title: Implement pot, side-pot, rake, and effective-stack accounting
tasks.description: Implement deterministic contribution accounting, uncalled-bet returns, side-pot construction, rake hooks, and effective-stack calculation from normalized actions.
acceptance_criteria: Side pots are correct for multiway unequal all-ins.
Uncalled excess chips are returned exactly once.
Chip conservation holds before configurable rake.
Property tests cover random legal contribution patterns.

tasks.title: Define normalized hand-history adapter contract
tasks.description: Define raw hand input, parser result, warnings/errors, provenance, table metadata, and normalized-hand versioning so venue-specific parsers remain isolated.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter interface supports partial/invalid input without silently fabricating actions.
Every normalized hand retains source identifier, source hash, parser version, and warnings.
Contract supports 2-10 seats, cash blinds/antes, and future tournament metadata.

tasks.title: Implement reference text hand-history parser
tasks.description: Implement one reference parser against fixture hand histories to prove the adapter contract, including all-ins, checks, raises, folds, showdowns, and uncalled returns.
acceptance_criteria: Parser reproduces expected normalized actions for all fixtures.
Unknown lines are reported with source location.
Malformed hands fail closed or produce explicit partial status.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic hand state machine
tasks.description: Replay normalized actions street by street, validate legal turn order and bet sizing, compute current pot/stacks/legal actions, and emit immutable snapshots at each decision point.
acceptance_criteria: Replaying the same normalized hand yields byte-stable decision snapshots.
Illegal actions are rejected with actionable invariant errors.
Heads-up and multiway betting order is correct preflop and postflop.
Snapshots expose effective stack, pot, amount-to-call, minimum raise, and active players.

tasks.title: Create normalized database schema and migrations
tasks.description: Create SQLAlchemy models and migrations for raw sources, normalized hands, players, aliases, actions, boards, decision points, imports, and version provenance using local SQLite by default with portable SQL boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Schema can recreate an empty database deterministically.
Foreign keys preserve hand/action/player provenance.
Raw input hashes and parser versions make reprocessing auditable.
SQLite WAL configuration and transaction boundaries are tested.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent import and deduplication
tasks.description: Persist normalized hands transactionally, deduplicate by stable source/content identity, and support safe reprocessing when parser versions change.
acceptance_criteria: Reimporting identical input creates no duplicate hand/action rows.
Parser-version reprocessing records lineage instead of overwriting history silently.
Partial failure rolls back the current import unit.

tasks.title: Materialize reusable decision and opportunity features
tasks.description: Create versioned derived features for positions, initiative, pot type, effective stack, facing action, sizing bucket, board descriptors, and legal opportunities.
acceptance_criteria: Derived rows link back to exact hand and decision snapshot.
Feature version changes can be recomputed without modifying raw normalized data.
Feature extraction is deterministic and batchable.

tasks.title: Implement indexed analytical query layer
tasks.description: Provide indexed queries over player, date/session, position, effective stack, pot type, street, board class, sizing, and action sequence with explainable filters.
acceptance_criteria: Representative HUD queries meet documented local latency targets on benchmark fixtures.
Every query exposes denominator/opportunity rows when used for statistics.
Indexes are migration-managed and benchmarked.

tasks.title: Implement generic opportunity evaluator
tasks.description: Represent each statistic as an opportunity predicate, success predicate, and dimensions so denominators reflect actual legal decisions.
acceptance_criteria: 3-bet, fold-to-3bet, c-bet, fold-to-cbet, steal, and BB-defense denominators are validated against golden hands.
Opportunities can exclude all-in/no-decision states and distinguish heads-up/multiway.
Definitions are versioned and introspectable.

tasks.title: Implement preflop base statistics
tasks.description: Implement the preflop measures specified in STATISTICS_CATALOG.md including VPIP, PFR, open, limp, iso, cold-call, 3/4/5-bet, squeeze, steal, blind defense, and response frequencies.
acceptance_criteria: Every statistic has machine-readable numerator/denominator semantics.
Golden examples include position-vs-position and facing-action variants.
All percentages expose successes, opportunities, raw rate, and definition version.

tasks.title: Implement postflop base statistics
tasks.description: Implement flop/turn/river continuation, probe, delayed c-bet, donk, check-raise, fold/call/raise versus bet, barrel, float, aggression, showdown, WWSF, WTSD, W$SD, and sizing-conditioned measures.
acceptance_criteria: Street-specific opportunity semantics are documented and tested.
Stats can distinguish IP/OOP, single-raised/3bet/4bet pots, heads-up/multiway, and sizing buckets.
Showdown and won-when-saw-flop metrics have exact inclusion rules.

tasks.title: Implement composable stat query DSL
tasks.description: Build a typed DSL combining measures with dimensions such as position, opponent position, stack, pot type, street, board texture, sizing, player count, initiative, time window, and session.
acceptance_criteria: Equivalent queries produce deterministic canonical forms and cache keys.
Unsupported or contradictory filters fail with clear diagnostics.
The DSL can express representative HUD popup queries without custom SQL.

tasks.title: Implement Bayesian shrinkage and credible intervals
tasks.description: For binomial frequency statistics, implement configurable Beta priors, posterior mean, credible intervals, effective sample reporting, and population-prior fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Posterior calculations match independent numerical fixtures within tolerance.
Raw rate is never hidden; posterior estimate and interval are displayed separately.
Zero-opportunity and extreme-count behavior is defined and tested.

tasks.title: Implement recency weighting and session/lifetime views
tasks.description: Support exponential half-life weighting, discrete recent windows, and session/lifetime splits without mixing their denominators.
acceptance_criteria: Half-life weighting matches documented formula.
Session and lifetime aggregates can be compared with exact sample metadata.
Recency is opt-in and raw unweighted counts remain accessible.

tasks.title: Implement exact chip and normalized-bb arithmetic
tasks.description: Define authoritative integer/Decimal arithmetic, conversion to big-blind units, rounding rules, tolerance policy, and serialization for all monetary/chip calculations.
acceptance_criteria: No authoritative pot/EV/chip amount uses binary float.
Rounding occurs only at explicit presentation or configured boundary points.
Conversions round-trip for fixture stake structures.

tasks.title: Implement pot odds, break-even, EV, MDF, and bluff/value formulas
tasks.description: Implement named pure functions for call pot odds, required equity, zero-equity bluff break-even fold rate, branch EV, MDF, polarized river bluff proportions, and sensitivity to rake.
acceptance_criteria: Each formula states units, pot timing convention, assumptions, and domain restrictions.
Tests include hand-calculated examples and algebraic identities.
Invalid states such as negative pot/call or impossible probabilities are rejected.

tasks.title: Implement SPR, risk/reward, implied-odds, and pot-growth utilities
tasks.description: Implement effective-stack SPR, geometric pot growth, future-call budget utilities, implied-odds threshold helpers, reverse-implied-odds inputs, and all-in risk/reward functions.
acceptance_criteria: SPR uses a documented street/pot convention.
Utilities expose assumptions rather than claiming unknowable future realization.
All-in and zero-stack edge cases are tested.

tasks.title: Implement poker combinatorics and card-removal primitives
tasks.description: Implement nCk, 1,326 Holdem starting-hand combos, pair/suited/offsuit combo counts, board-card removal, blocker-conditioned counts, and weighted-combo aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: There are exactly 1,326 unordered two-card Holdem combinations.
Canonical class counts are 6 pair, 4 suited, and 12 offsuit combos before removal.
Card-removal results match exhaustive enumeration fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement confidence, variance, calibration, and error metrics
tasks.description: Implement Beta posterior helpers, credible intervals, weighted effective sample size, Monte Carlo standard error, Brier/calibration metrics, and EV/regret aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics match SciPy/reference fixtures where applicable.
Weighted effective sample size behavior is documented for recency weighting.
No confidence score is emitted without an interpretable underlying quantity.

tasks.title: Implement correct 5-card and 7-card hand evaluation
tasks.description: Implement or integrate a deterministic evaluator for high-card through straight flush, with canonical tie breakers and exhaustive category ordering tests.
acceptance_criteria: All hand categories and tie-break rules match reference fixtures.
Seven-card evaluation selects the best five-card hand.
Randomized cross-checking against an independent oracle detects no mismatches in the configured test sample.

tasks.title: Implement board texture and runout classifier
tasks.description: Classify board rank structure, pairedness, suit structure, connectivity, straight/flush completion density, high-card class, and turn/river transition deltas.
acceptance_criteria: Classification is invariant to suit isomorphisms when labels are irrelevant.
Paired/monotone/two-tone/rainbow and connectivity fixtures are exhaustive for representative classes.
Runout delta identifies cards that pair, complete flushes, or materially change straight structure.

tasks.title: Implement 1,326-combo weighted range model
tasks.description: Represent every legal two-card combo with weight [0,1], normalization utilities, dead-card removal, grouping by canonical hand class, and deterministic serialization.
acceptance_criteria: Range cannot assign positive weight to combos containing known dead cards after conditioning.
Total weighted combos and normalized mass are reproducible.
Serialization preserves exact combo identity and weight tolerance.

tasks.title: Implement range notation parser and formatter
tasks.description: Parse and format common poker notation such as 22+, A2s+, KQo, explicit combos, percentages, and weighted overrides into the canonical range model.
acceptance_criteria: Parser round-trips supported notation deterministically.
Ambiguous or invalid notation produces precise errors.
Explicit combo weights override class defaults in a documented order.

tasks.title: Implement action-conditioned range update pipeline
tasks.description: Update prior combo weights from position/action/sizing/board evidence via versioned likelihood models while retaining prior, likelihood, posterior, and normalization trace.
acceptance_criteria: Posterior is proportional to prior × likelihood and is normalized after dead-card removal.
A zero-information likelihood leaves the prior unchanged apart from card removal.
Every update stores model/version/evidence used so it can be replayed.

tasks.title: Implement exact showdown equity enumeration
tasks.description: Enumerate all legal opponent combinations and future runouts for tractable states, handling ties, dead cards, weighted ranges, and deterministic accumulation.
acceptance_criteria: Known equity fixtures match independent oracle values within exact/rational tolerance.
Tie equity is split correctly.
Enumeration never samples or double-counts runouts.

tasks.title: Implement seeded Monte Carlo equity simulation
tasks.description: Implement reproducible seeded simulation with legal weighted sampling, confidence/standard-error estimates, early stopping by precision, and cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Same seed/configuration produces identical results.
Results converge to exact enumeration on small states within statistical tolerance.
Reported uncertainty shrinks with effective sample size and never claims exactness.

tasks.title: Implement range-vs-range and multiway equity
tasks.description: Compute hero-vs-range, range-vs-range, and multiway equities with blocker-consistent joint sampling/enumeration and per-player tie handling.
acceptance_criteria: Joint opponent hands never share cards.
Equity shares sum to 1 within tolerance for every completed simulation.
Heads-up results agree with single-opponent engine.

tasks.title: Implement player profile aggregates
tasks.description: Build queryable lifetime/recent/session profiles containing raw and posterior stats, samples, confidence, positions, sizings, and spot dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: Profile never merges incompatible definition versions silently.
Every displayed rate includes sample/opportunity metadata.
Session/recent/lifetime views are independently queryable.

tasks.title: Implement population priors and cohorts
tasks.description: Aggregate de-identified local cohorts by game/stakes/table format/player archetype dimensions and expose priors for sparse-player estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort membership rules are versioned and auditable.
A player is excluded from their own prior when configured to avoid leakage.
Sparse cohorts fall back through a documented hierarchy.

tasks.title: Detect statistically meaningful behavior changes
tasks.description: Detect recent-vs-baseline changes using posterior comparisons/change-point heuristics and require minimum evidence before surfacing a change.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic no-change sequences have bounded false alert rates in tests.
Large synthetic shifts are detected after configurable evidence thresholds.
Alerts show old/new estimates, samples, interval overlap, and method.

tasks.title: Generate evidence-backed automatic player notes
tasks.description: Generate structured notes such as overfold/underdefend/high aggression only when a named comparison baseline and evidence threshold are satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Every note links to metric, filter, player estimate, baseline estimate, sample, and confidence.
Low-confidence deviations are suppressed or explicitly labeled uncertain.
Notes are deterministic for the same profile snapshot.

tasks.title: Define versioned strategy and information-set schema
tasks.description: Define information-set keys, legal actions, sizing identifiers, action frequencies, counterfactual/EV values, abstraction metadata, solver provenance, and confidence fields.
acceptance_criteria: Strategy entries reject illegal action probabilities and normalize within tolerance.
Schema distinguishes exact/precomputed/imported/abstract/estimated sources.
Information-set key is deterministic for a given abstraction version.

tasks.title: Implement preflop strategy lookup and range library
tasks.description: Store and query weighted preflop strategies by table format, stack, positions, prior action sequence, sizing, and game parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Lookup supports open/call/3bet/4bet/jam/fold trees with mixed frequencies.
Missing exact stack/sizing returns explicit interpolation/fallback metadata rather than silent guessing.
Imported ranges are versioned with source/provenance.

tasks.title: Implement postflop baseline abstraction lookup
tasks.description: Map canonical spots to versioned postflop strategy abstractions by pot type, positions, stack/SPR, board class, action history, and sizing menu.
acceptance_criteria: Lookup reports exact matched dimensions and abstraction distance.
Absent strategy data never fabricates GTO frequencies.
Board suit isomorphisms are handled consistently when supported.

tasks.title: Implement bounded exploit adjustment engine
tasks.description: Adjust baseline frequencies/sizings only from statistically supported opponent/population deviations, with caps, confidence gates, and sensitivity output.
acceptance_criteria: With neutral opponent evidence the adjusted strategy equals baseline.
Adjustment magnitude is monotone with configured deviation evidence within tested regimes.
Output separates baseline action mix, adjustment, evidence, and final mix.

tasks.title: Implement strategy explanation trace
tasks.description: Produce machine-readable and human-readable reasoning showing range/equity, pot geometry, baseline strategy, exploit evidence, uncertainty, and key blockers without hiding assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Explanation contains provenance for every numeric input.
Contradictory/low-confidence signals are surfaced, not averaged invisibly.
No explanation labels an approximate solver result as exact.

tasks.title: Benchmark practical solver architecture
tasks.description: Run the solver spike: compare CFR/CFR+/MCCFR, action/card abstractions, depth-limited re-solving, external strategy import, hardware needs, convergence metrics, and integration contracts; write an ADR.
acceptance_criteria: ADR records evaluated alternatives, benchmark setup, hardware assumptions, selected path, reversibility, and non-goals.
The selected path defines what can and cannot be called GTO/equilibrium.
At least one toy benchmark is reproducible locally.

tasks.title: Implement CFR/CFR+ correctness ladder on toy poker games
tasks.description: Implement Kuhn and Leduc poker game trees plus CFR/CFR+ with regret matching, average strategy, exploitability/best-response checks where tractable, and convergence plots/data.
acceptance_criteria: Kuhn equilibrium frequencies/convergence match accepted analytic/reference values within tolerance.
Regret and average-strategy updates are deterministic for fixed traversal ordering.
Tests catch sign, reach-probability, and counterfactual-weighting errors.

tasks.title: Implement no-limit action/card abstraction prototype
tasks.description: Implement configurable action sizing abstraction and card/board bucketing prototype with explicit mapping error metrics and deterministic tree generation.
acceptance_criteria: Tree builder respects no-limit betting legality and stack caps.
Every concrete-to-abstract mapping reports abstraction version.
Benchmark reports state count, memory estimate, and abstraction collisions.

tasks.title: Prototype depth-limited subgame re-solving
tasks.description: Implement a bounded re-solving prototype using the selected solver architecture with configurable depth/actions, range inputs, leaf-value interface, cancellation, and convergence diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype solves toy/limited benchmark spots reproducibly.
Latency, iterations, memory, and convergence diagnostics are captured.
Failure to converge returns explicit uncertain status rather than a confident strategy.

tasks.title: Implement compressed strategy storage and lookup
tasks.description: Implement chunked/versioned strategy serialization, compression, indexed information-set lookup, checksums, and migration/version compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Strategy artifacts are checksum-verified and versioned.
Lookup is deterministic and benchmarked for HUD use.
Corrupt/incompatible artifacts fail closed with recovery guidance.

tasks.title: Build canonical decision spot assembler
tasks.description: Assemble current game snapshot, hero hand, board, pot geometry, legal actions, player ranges, opponent stats, population priors, and strategy context into a versioned immutable DecisionSpot.
acceptance_criteria: Spot contains no hidden global state and serializes deterministically.
Every inferred input records source/provenance/confidence.
Unknown hero cards or missing context are represented explicitly.

tasks.title: Generate legal candidate actions and sizings
tasks.description: Generate check/fold/call/raise/all-in actions plus configurable geometric, pot-fraction, and strategy-specified sizings, respecting minimum raise and effective stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Every generated action is legal under the state machine.
Duplicate-equivalent sizings are canonicalized.
All-in and short-stack min-raise edge cases are tested.

tasks.title: Implement branch-based action EV comparator
tasks.description: Evaluate candidate actions through fold/call/raise branches using conditional ranges, equity, pot/rake geometry, future-node estimates, and explicit uncertainty propagation.
acceptance_criteria: Simple terminal decisions reduce exactly to the documented closed-form EV formulas.
Branch probabilities sum to 1 within tolerance or return invalid-state error.
EV result includes assumptions, branch contributions, uncertainty, and sensitivity to key inputs.

tasks.title: Implement recommendation, mixed-strategy, and confidence policy
tasks.description: Combine baseline strategy, exploit adjustment, direct EV comparison, solver result, and confidence into a recommendation without collapsing close actions into false certainty.
acceptance_criteria: Output includes action frequencies, EV estimates, EV gaps, confidence, and source hierarchy.
Near-tied actions remain mixed/ambiguous under configurable tolerance.
Unsupported spots return study guidance/insufficient-model status rather than invented advice.

tasks.title: Implement PySide6 overlay shell and table instances
tasks.description: Create transparent click-through/configurable desktop overlay windows, DPI-aware scaling, per-table instance lifecycle, and safe shutdown/recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay can create/destroy multiple independent table instances.
Layout coordinates scale correctly across configured DPI factors.
Application state survives a UI restart without corrupting analytical data.

tasks.title: Implement seat mapping and player binding
tasks.description: Map logical seats/player aliases to screen layout coordinates and support manual correction when automatic metadata is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Seat mapping is table-layout versioned and deterministic.
Manual override is persistent per layout and reversible.
Unknown/empty seats do not inherit stale player data.

tasks.title: Implement compact stat panels and confidence display
tasks.description: Render configurable stat packs with raw rate, posterior estimate, sample size, confidence/interval cues, and context-aware color-free semantic states.
acceptance_criteria: Panel refresh does not block the UI thread.
Each stat can expose definition and filter summary.
Missing/low-sample data is visually distinct from true zero.

tasks.title: Implement deep stat popup explorer
tasks.description: Provide tabbed/filtered popup views for preflop/flop/turn/river/position/sizing/board/showdown/range notes using the stat DSL.
acceptance_criteria: Popup queries are generated through the DSL rather than bespoke SQL.
Filters show current denominator/sample and can be reset predictably.
Slow queries are cancellable and cached by canonical query key.

tasks.title: Implement live decision panel with explanation
tasks.description: Render current spot, legal actions, recommended mix, EV deltas, equity/range summary, exploit evidence, confidence, and explanation trace for environments where live assistance is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Panel identifies stale/incomplete spot data prominently.
UI labels exact vs estimated/abstract solver outputs.
Update latency and cancellation behavior meet the documented performance budget.

tasks.title: Implement interactive hand replayer model
tasks.description: Create a replay timeline exposing each decision snapshot, pot/stacks, board, actions, stats, ranges, equity, and strategy annotations.
acceptance_criteria: Replay state at every action matches state-machine snapshots.
Users can step streets/actions without recomputation drift.
Annotations declare whether they were known at play time or computed post hoc.

tasks.title: Grade decisions by modeled EV loss and strategic divergence
tasks.description: Compare taken action to available action EVs/baseline mix and store decision-grade records with confidence and model version.
acceptance_criteria: EV loss is zero/near-zero for modeled best-equivalent actions within tolerance.
Grades never compare across incompatible model versions without labeling.
Low-confidence spots are excluded or downweighted in aggregate leak ranking.

tasks.title: Detect and rank recurring player leaks
tasks.description: Aggregate graded decisions into interpretable spot classes and rank by cumulative modeled EV loss, frequency, confidence, and recency.
acceptance_criteria: Leak groups expose exact filter definition and supporting hand IDs.
Ranking separates frequency from per-occurrence severity.
Minimum sample/confidence thresholds prevent one-off outliers from dominating.

tasks.title: Generate adaptive drills from detected leaks
tasks.description: Generate reproducible study queues from leak classes, synthetic/real historical spots, target concepts, answer scoring, and explanation feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Every drill stores source/provenance and correct answer model version.
Repeated drills can vary cards/runouts without changing targeted concept when configured.
Trainer can operate entirely from post-session data.

tasks.title: Implement mastery and spaced-repetition scheduling
tasks.description: Track concept mastery and schedule review based on accuracy, EV-regret severity, confidence, and time since practice.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduling is deterministic for a fixed learner history.
Mastery is concept-specific and does not leak across unrelated spot classes.
Users can reset or inspect scheduling state.

tasks.title: Implement session and longitudinal study reports
tasks.description: Produce session summaries, win/loss context, decision EV loss, position/spot trends, uncertainty-aware stats, top leaks, and a prioritized study queue.
acceptance_criteria: Reports distinguish observed monetary outcome from modeled decision quality.
All aggregates are reproducible from stored hand/model versions.
Export omits raw private data unless explicitly requested.

tasks.title: Implement local FastAPI service
tasks.description: Expose versioned local endpoints for imports, players, stats, spots, equity, decisions, replays, reports, and health while keeping authoritative logic in domain services.
acceptance_criteria: API schemas are versioned and generated from typed models.
Long-running equity/solver jobs are cancellable.
Local service binds safely by default and rejects malformed inputs.

tasks.title: Implement import/analyze/query/benchmark CLI
tasks.description: Provide CLI workflows for importing hands, validating parsers, querying stats, computing equity/EV, analyzing sessions, and running benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: CLI has machine-readable JSON output mode.
Commands return non-zero status on validation/calculation failure.
Dry-run/import validation can run without mutating the database.

tasks.title: Prove target-environment live data adapter contract
tasks.description: Use the target environment available to the operator to identify the structured live hand/state feed, latency, identity mapping, lifecycle, and failure behavior; document the supported adapter boundary without OCR assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: ADR identifies exact available data source and permission assumptions.
Prototype captures a sanitized fixture stream for deterministic tests.
If no stable structured feed exists, live integration remains blocked while post-session functions proceed.

tasks.title: Implement versioned adapter/plugin SDK
tasks.description: Define isolated adapters for hand histories, live structured events, strategy imports, and table metadata with capability declarations and validation.
acceptance_criteria: Adapters declare input schema, capabilities, version, and trust boundary.
Invalid plugin output cannot bypass domain validation.
Reference adapter tests run without network access.

tasks.title: Implement schema-validated configuration and user profiles
tasks.description: Implement configuration for database, stake normalization, stat packs, layouts, solver budgets, priors, recency, strategy versions, and feature flags with migrations/defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid configuration fails with field-specific diagnostics.
Configuration versions migrate deterministically.
Secrets/credentials are never stored in ordinary profile exports.

tasks.title: Implement calculation traces and reproducibility ledger
tasks.description: Record structured diagnostics for imports, stats definitions, range updates, equity seeds, decision model versions, solver artifacts, and benchmark environment.
acceptance_criteria: A decision report can enumerate the exact versions/seeds/artifacts that produced it.
Logs redact private hand/player data by default.
Trace IDs connect UI/API output to calculation records.

tasks.title: Build golden hand and decision corpus
tasks.description: Create sanitized fixtures covering heads-up/multiway, limps, squeezes, 3/4bet pots, all-ins, side pots, uncalled bets, rake, weird sizings, showdowns, folds, and malformed input.
acceptance_criteria: Corpus has expected normalized actions and state snapshots.
Each edge case states which invariant/stat/math behavior it validates.
Fixtures contain no personal or secret data.

tasks.title: Add property-based game/range/equity invariants
tasks.description: Use generated legal states to test chip conservation, card uniqueness, range mass, probability bounds, equity sums, state replay determinism, and EV algebraic identities.
acceptance_criteria: Generated tests preserve enough seeds/examples to reproduce failures.
Core invariants run in ordinary CI within a bounded budget.
Slow exhaustive properties are separately tagged.

tasks.title: Create performance benchmark suite and budgets
tasks.description: Benchmark import throughput, stat query latency, exact/MC equity, range updates, decision assembly, HUD refresh, memory, and solver prototypes on fixed fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmarks report hardware/software environment and dataset size.
Regression thresholds are documented by workload rather than one global time.
Benchmark results are machine-readable.

tasks.title: Introduce native acceleration only for measured hotspots
tasks.description: After profiling, implement a Rust/PyO3 or C++ boundary for the highest-impact pure calculation kernel while preserving a Python oracle/reference implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Native path demonstrates a measured speedup on the selected benchmark.
Python/native results match within exact/tolerance contract over randomized fixtures.
System falls back safely when native extension is unavailable.

tasks.title: Harden local data, plugins, and failure recovery
tasks.description: Threat-model local API, parser/plugin inputs, corrupt strategy files, database recovery, path handling, exports, and crash consistency; implement validation and recovery controls.
acceptance_criteria: Threat model identifies trust boundaries and mitigations.
Malformed/untrusted adapter or strategy data cannot execute arbitrary instructions through data paths.
Recovery procedures are tested against interrupted imports and corrupt artifacts.

tasks.title: Expose blocker and nut-combo analysis
tasks.description: Compute blockers/unblockers, nut-combo availability, value/draw class counts, and hand-class removal deltas for explanation and range analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Counts reconcile exactly with conditioned weighted range.
Known-card removal is applied before nut/draw classification.
Output is deterministic and explanation-ready.

tasks.title: Classify range into made-hand and draw classes
tasks.description: Classify each combo on a board into hand strength, pair class, overcards, straight/flush draws, combo draws, nuttiness, and showdown-value buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Combo classifications are mutually consistent and can be multi-label for draw properties.
Class masses sum back to the input range where partitions are defined.
River classifications contain no impossible draw labels.

tasks.title: Model rake and fee effects in EV/equity thresholds
tasks.description: Implement configurable rake/fee functions and integrate them into terminal pot, call threshold, and action-EV calculations with clear site/venue configuration boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: No-rake configuration reduces exactly to base formulas.
Caps/percentage schedules are deterministic and unit-tested.
Decision outputs disclose whether rake is included and which schedule/version was used.

tasks.title: Implement advanced aggression and line-frequency metrics
tasks.description: Add AF, AFq, bet/raise/fold line frequencies, double/triple barrels, delayed lines, probe sequences, river overbet/block-bet, and response-by-sizing metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Line metrics use legal opportunity denominators and documented street histories.
Sizing-conditioned metrics use canonical buckets plus raw amount filters.
Multiway exclusions/inclusions are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement outcome and variance statistics separated from decision quality
tasks.description: Compute bb/100, all-in adjusted placeholders when supported, session variance, standard error, positional results, and showdown/non-showdown outcomes while clearly separating monetary outcomes from strategy quality.
acceptance_criteria: bb/100 uses normalized big-blind units with stake-change handling.
Outcome stats document rake inclusion and currency/bb normalization.
Reports never use short-term winrate as a proxy for decision correctness.

tasks.title: Implement interpretable player archetype clustering
tasks.description: Create optional interpretable clustering/segmentation from stable profile features with minimum samples, standardization, versioned model, and no forced label when confidence is low.
acceptance_criteria: Archetype assignment records model version, features, and distance/confidence.
Low-sample players remain unclassified or prior-driven.
Cluster labels are descriptive configuration, not hard-coded strategic truth.

tasks.title: Implement recommendation sensitivity analysis
tasks.description: Recompute or approximate action EV/ranking under plausible range, fold-frequency, sizing, and equity uncertainty to show when a recommendation is fragile.
acceptance_criteria: Sensitivity ranges are derived from explicit uncertainty intervals/configuration.
Fragile recommendations are labeled when action ordering changes within plausible inputs.
Results identify the variables driving the largest EV change.

tasks.title: Implement HUD layout/stat-pack editor
tasks.description: Allow creation/versioning of stat packs, popup groups, table layouts, font/scale settings, confidence/sample display rules, and profile import/export.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration changes preview without corrupting active table state.
Export/import is schema-versioned.
Invalid stat IDs or filters are rejected with guidance.

tasks.title: Implement safe CSV/JSON/Parquet analytical export
tasks.description: Export normalized hands, selected features, stats, and study data with explicit schemas and redaction controls for offline analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Exports are deterministic for a fixed snapshot/query.
Private raw text/player aliases can be excluded or pseudonymized.
Schema version is embedded in exported metadata.

proposed_sprint.goal: Establish a mathematically safe core that can represent hands, account for pots/side-pots, use exact chip arithmetic, and persist normalized domain data with deterministic tests.
rationale: Creates the shared types and numerical conventions used by every later subsystem.
Validates pot/side-pot accounting and persistence boundaries before state/statistics depend on them.
Uses 10 of the default 12 capacity units, leaving deliberate integration slack.
